title: AI Marketing Operations Manager
description:
About the Role We are a high-growth psychiatric practice that is expanding to 15 states via telemedicine, alongside a specialized physical clinic in Fairfax, VA (focused on TMS and Ketamine). We have moved away from traditional agency models to a high-efficiency AI-Augmented Stack. We are looking for an Operations Manager to "pilot" this machine. You are not responsible for manual content writing or manual keyword bidding; you are responsible for orchestrating tools and ensuring clinical ROI. The Tech Stack You Will Manage CRM: HubSpot Enterprise (including Breeze AI / Content Hub). Ads & Technical SEO: (Managed PPC & SEO). Local/State SEO & Reviews: KiwiHealth (Virtual Proximity Engine). Project Management: ClickUp. Key Responsibilities AI Content Orchestration: Use HubSpot Breeze to generate localized landing pages for 15 states and clinical blogs. Audit their weekly PPC reports to ensure our Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) remains healthy and negative keywords are being filtered. Reputation & GEO-SEO: Manage KiwiHealth to respond to patient reviews (HIPAA-compliant) and ensure our "Virtual Proximity" listings are accurate across 15 states. Closed-Loop Reporting: Maintain a HubSpot Enterprise dashboard that tracks the journey from "Ad Click" to "Booked Appointment" to "5-Star Review." Requirements HubSpot Enterprise Proficiency: You must understand Workflows, Custom Objects, and the Breeze AI Content Agent. AI-Native Workflow: You prefer using AI and productized services over manual labor. Healthcare Experience (Preferred): Understanding of HIPAA compliance and medical search intent (TMS, Ketamine, Psychiatry). Data-Driven: You focus on CPA and Conversion Rates, not "vanity metrics" like clicks or impressions. title: AI Engineer
description: Are you a passionate and enthusiastic AI professional looking to build your career in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and intelligent automation? Join LevelShift as an AI Engineer, where you'll design AI-native solutions, build intelligent automation pipelines, and develop next-generation AI applications that solve real business problems. You'll collaborate with product teams, software engineers, data professionals, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and production-ready AI solutions that accelerate digital transformation. What You'll Do As an AI Engineer at LevelShift, you will: Build intelligent pipelines utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) for reasoning, document generation, summarization, content extraction, and task automation. Design and develop autonomous AI workflows where AI agents interact with tools, APIs, memory, external systems, and other agents to solve complex business problems using Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and planning techniques. Analyze and modernize existing enterprise applications, rule-based systems, stored procedures, and legacy workflows into AI-native solutions capable of processing structured and unstructured data. Develop secure, scalable, and production-ready AI applications by integrating LLMs with enterprise systems, cloud platforms, databases, and business processes while following responsible AI and governance best practices. Collaborate with internal teams and customer-facing stakeholders to identify AI adoption opportunities, recommend innovative solutions, and continuously improve business processes through intelligent automation. How this role uses AI Utilize Generative AI throughout the software development lifecycle to accelerate development, automate repetitive engineering tasks, improve documentation, and enhance productivity. Leverage AI-powered tools for prompt optimization, code generation, workflow automation, testing, reasoning, and intelligent knowledge retrieval. Work with modern AI technologies such as Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, vector databases, and AI agent frameworks to build enterprise-grade AI solutions. Your Skillset Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field with 5+ years of experience in AI Engineering, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, or Generative AI. Strong hands-on experience building applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, and AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or AutoGen. Proficiency in Python, REST APIs, cloud platforms (preferably Azure), and integrating AI services with enterprise applications, databases, and business systems. Good understanding of AI governance, responsible AI, model evaluation, security, structured and unstructured data processing, and modern AI application architectures. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with a passion for learning emerging AI technologies, collaborating in Agile teams, and delivering scalable AI-driven business solutions. This is an entry-level position designed for a recent or upcoming graduate beginning their software engineering career.As JPI continues to expand and modernize its AI and software development ecosystem, this role contributes directly to the agents, applications, and integrations that advance our digital strategy and transform building. It is structured for deliberate growth: responsibilities expand as demonstrated capability grows, with senior review and mentorship as the constant.Essential Functions & ResponsibilitiesAgentic AI DevelopmentBuild, test, and maintain agentic AI applications, AI-powered automations, and RPA solutions under the direction of senior developers. Write backend logic and APIs for internal web-based applications, and build responsive, accessible user interface components to the front-end standards set by senior engineers. Translate assigned technical specifications into working, tested code, and produce the accompanying documentation for integration workflows, APIs, and agent configurations.
